title: Gharol's Message
description: Gharol, the blacksmith of Dushnikh Yal, forged a sword to channel her feelings about her estranged daughter Lash and asks you to deliver it to Lash in Karthwasten.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Dushnikh Yal.
Orcs infuse their weapons with private emotions: anger, regret, pride.
My daughter Lash left the stronghold, breaking Orc custom and bringing me shame and grief.

GHAROL_MESSAGE_LEARN: I forged a sword to channel my feelings about my daughter's betrayal and to send her a message.
I want someone to bring the sword to Lash in Karthwasten; she will know what it means.
GHAROL_MESSAGE_ACCEPT: Someone has agreed to deliver my sword to Lash.

base_facts: I left the Orc stronghold Dushnikh Yal, breaking with custom.

GHAROL_MESSAGE_DELIVER: My mother's sword was delivered to me. The message is clear: don't come back.
I rewarded the courier with gold for honoring my mother's task.

beats.comment: Player learns about Gharol's daughter and the sword she forged as a message.
Player accepts the task to deliver Gharol's sword to Lash in Karthwasten.
Player delivers the sword to Lash in Karthwasten; quest completes at stage 200.
